translations.web: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”
translations.bsb: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear what they fear; do not be shaken.”
translations.kjv: But and if ye suffer for righteousness' sake, happy are ye: and be ➔ not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;
